items.title: MNK Group appoints former American Coastal executive as Florida Re CEO
items.summary: Chris Griffith takes over leadership at Florida Insurance and Reinsurance Co. following the departure of Alvaro Ortiz.

items.title: UK insurers face claims intake scrutiny as motor loss ratios rise
items.summary: UK motor insurers grappling with high loss ratios are examining how connected first notification of loss processes can satisfy regulatory demands under the Consumer Duty.

items.title: JP Morgan chief Jamie Dimon pledges to offset upcoming UK bank tax rise
items.summary: JP Morgan chief executive Jamie Dimon has said the bank will find ways to claw back the cost of an incoming rise in the UK bank surcharge.

items.title: High Court dismisses jurisdiction challenge in UK broker offshore call centre claim
items.summary: Thirty South African call centre workers are proceeding with a High Court damages claim against a UK motor insurance broker after an English judge dismissed jurisdictional challenges.

items.title: Brown & Riding appoints Anna Vu to management and professional liability practice
items.summary: Insurance brokerage Brown & Riding has appointed Anna Vu to its national management and professional liability practice.

items.title: Brokers warned not to mistake quieter FCA rhetoric for lower supervisory expectations
items.summary: Insurance brokers have been cautioned by PKF Littlejohn that the Financial Conduct Authority's shift toward growth and competitiveness does not signal a reduction in regulatory standards.
